meta.source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal
meta.coverage: India, cooling, heating, wind, sun and air: CMIP6 20-year averages and changes from 1995-2014, for 2020-2039, 2040-2059, 2060-2079, 2080-2099 (each dated by its first year; 1995 is the 1995-2014 reference).
meta.note: CMIP6 multi-model ensemble (about 30 models), downscaled and bias-corrected to 0.25° by CCKP. Projections are model output under a stated scenario, not observations; the 10th to 90th percentile is the spread across models.
